bull.b: Durable, immunomodulator-free improvements across multiple autoimmune measures provide evidence that rese-cel may deliver sustained clinical benefit. The favorable safety profile across 71 patients also supports continued development and strengthens Cabaletta’s position in autoimmune cell therapy.

Low leverage limits balance-sheet pressure compared with a heavily debt-funded biotechnology model and preserves some financial flexibility. This may help Cabaletta continue funding clinical programs without immediate reliance on substantial interest-bearing obligations.

The substantial warrant proceeds strengthen near-term liquidity and can support ongoing clinical development and operating needs. Greater cash flexibility may allow Cabaletta to advance programs and reach important milestones before requiring another financing.

bear.b: Without approved products or recurring sales, Cabaletta lacks an established commercial revenue base to fund operations. Its financial outlook therefore remains dependent on successful clinical development, future partnering or additional external capital.

Losses have expanded materially as Cabaletta increases operating investment without a revenue base. Persistent and worsening deficits reduce financial resilience, raise the capital required to reach commercialization, and make future profitability dependent on successful pipeline execution.

Increasing cash consumption creates a recurring funding requirement while clinical programs remain in development. Continued burn can shorten the company’s financial runway and may force additional financing, potentially limiting strategic flexibility or diluting existing shareholders.
